description: This PHP class defines the entity 'SelectedDisplayFieldGroup' used in the OrangeHRM system, representing a database table 'ohrm_selected_display_field_group'. It includes properties for ID, associated Report, and DisplayFieldGroup entities, along with getter and setter methods. The class uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and a DecoratorTrait for additional functionality.

classes.name: SelectedDisplayFieldGroup
classes.description: Entity class for the 'ohrm_selected_display_field_group' table, representing a group of display fields linked to reports.
